PRIMARY ROLE
NEPRA is the electricity-sector regulator. Its Complaint Management System and Complaint Handling & Dispute Resolution Procedure Rules, 2015 cover consumer complaints and disputes involving electricity licensees. The Consumer Service

s and disputes involving electricity licensees. The Consumer Service Manual applies to consumers served by Distribution Companies (DISCOs) and Bulk Power Consumers.

For an ordinary electricity-service problem, the consumer should normally first approach the relevant Distribution Company (for example IESCO) and the concerned SDO/XEN. NEPRA's current complaint-registration

concerned SDO/XEN. NEPRA's current complaint-registration page specifically advises consumers to complain to the concerned SDO/XEN before lodging the matter with NEPRA.

. Under the 2023 amendment, Councils of Complaints also handle certain grievances of electronic-media employees concerning non-payment of wages, salaries and dues.
